t: Makita 18V 5.0Ah Li-Ion LXT battery delivers dependable power for a wide range of cordless tools. The robust BL1850B power tool battery ensures extended run times and consistent performance, making it ideal for professional tradespeople on demanding job sites, from carpentry to electrical installations. A 4-stage LED fuel gauge indicator allows for easy monitoring of charge levels. Multi-contact terminals reduce electrical resistance and enhance connection stability, ensuring a steady current supply even under vibration. Charges in approximately 45 minutes with Makita DC18RC and DC18RD chargers, or 110 minutes with the DC18SD charger (chargers sold separately). The lightweight, shock-absorbing 0.6 kg battery extended run time and minimal power depletion during storage. Can be charged at any time, with no discharging required.
